description: A distorted low pass filter, the maker's take on a 303 style acid filter

params.text: Sets the resonance; the filter does not resonate with nothing patched into it
Sets the cutoff frequency of the filter

inputs.text: A voltage added to the resonance set by RISORSTORE; negative voltage is rectified rather than lowering it
A voltage added to the cutoff set by CUTOFF; voltage below zero is ignored, and with the knob near the bottom of its travel the voltage moves the cutoff very little
